selectionRationale: Official signed stable moby/buildkit v0.32.2 release current at Phase 8D1 pre-publish hardening. The GitHub-hosted build jobs are linux/amd64 only, so the workflow pins the unique linux/amd64 platform manifest directly while retaining the repository index digest as an independent provenance anchor. Buildx v0.12.1 is pinned because it supports the required attestations but does not auto-grant network.host for a docker-container builder unless driver network=host is explicitly selected. The OCI worker is forced to bridge mode; BuildKit v0.32.2 resolves and reports that bridge provider as cni. security.insecure and network.host remain unavailable while ordinary sandboxed dependency downloads remain available.
